title: The Creepy Crawl
style: Halloween novelty party song, 60s surf-rock and doo-wop swing meets modern electro-swing dance-pop beat, 124 BPM, spooky haunted organ, theremin, twangy reverb surf guitar, crunchy bass, campy deep baritone male narrator vocal, ghoulish doo-wop backing choir, call-and-response hook, handclaps, fun and a little scary
negativeTags: ballad, sad, metal screaming, lo-fi, country, gore
lyrics:
[Intro: spooky organ, theremin swoop]
[Spoken, campy baritone] Good evening, boils and ghouls... the crypt is open, the bass is loud, and tonight... the dead want to dance.

[Verse 1]
Down at the manor where the candles drip
A skeleton DJ cut a brand-new clip
The werewolf howled, the mummy came unwound
Every coffin lid went bumpin' to the sound

[Pre-Chorus]
Knees go knockin', teeth go clack
Once you start it, there's no goin' back

[Chorus]
Do the Creepy Crawl! (Creepy Crawl!)
Slide your bones along the wall! (Along the wall!)
Shake it like you're three days dead
Spin your eyeballs, nod your head
Everybody — do the Creepy Crawl! (Ooh-ooh, Creepy Crawl!)

[Verse 2]
Vampire countess in her velvet cape
Moonwalked backward out the fire escape
The witches stirred a groove into the stew
And the zombie at the door said "Brains? ...Nah, shoes!"

[Bridge: call-and-response]
When I say "Creepy" — you say "Crawl!" (Crawl!)
Creepy! (Crawl!) Creepy! (Crawl!)
Now drag your left foot... now drag your right...
[Spoken] Not like that. You're too alive.

[Instrumental Break: surf guitar, theremin solo, crunchy bass]

[Chorus]
Do the Creepy Crawl! (Creepy Crawl!)
Slide your bones along the wall! (Along the wall!)
Shake it like you're three days dead
Spin your eyeballs, nod your head
Everybody — do the Creepy Crawl! (Ooh-ooh, Creepy Crawl!)

[Outro: ghoulish choir fades, evil cackle]
[Spoken] Same time next year... if you survive the dance floor.
[End]
